title: GMS Week 44 - Buyers Raise The Stakes
section_path: GMS Week 44 - Buyers Raise The Stakes
section_path_text: GMS Week 44 - Buyers Raise The Stakes
summary:
Main
Last week's recovery in dry freight offered recycling buyers little encouragement. This week, however, sentiment has improvedacross the sub-continent, with recyclers showing greater willingness to compete for available tonnage. Bangladesh continues to lead the market, while Pakistan and India are also displaying renewed confidence.
